scope: Frontend-only; local React demo with synthetic MSW

viewportReflow.evidence: W29: 9 viewport widths, 7 representative profiles, Chromium and Firefox, 18 cases, 0 issue/page error

domTextAndSpacingStress.method: Visible text elements receive a direct 2x computed font-size style, with synthetic letter/word spacing and line-height overrides

nativeTextResize200.method: Firefox native Zoom Text Only; zoomFullPage=false and zoomFactor=2, with fixed CSS viewport and device-pixel ratio

actualBrowserZoom200.browser: Playwright-bundled Chromium 153.0.8010.12, headed, fresh temporary profile
actualBrowserZoom200.method: Temporary Manifest V3 extension applies chrome.tabs.setZoom(tabId, 2) and verifies chrome.tabs.getZoom(tabId) === 2; no CSS/device-scale/viewport emulation

productFixes: Responsive short label for the demo status chip prevents toolbar overflow at 320px while preserving its accessible name
Long input labels and status chips may wrap rather than clip
Keyboard focus ring now covers navigation list items
Avatar minimum dimensions grow with the text line-height tokens to prevent clipping
limitations: DOM text scaling does not prove native text resize; Firefox native text-only and Chromium browser zoom were tested separately
Visual review covers the five recorded synthetic scenarios only; it does not establish screen-reader conformance, all routes, or all browsers
